text:
maria: CI turned red on the serving unit tests in this PR (https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4021). Failing test: ServeRetryTest.test_retry_window_reschedule. Looks timing-y, only fails on linux-amd64 runner.

srini: @maria can you paste the failing log tail?

maria: sure -- here's the last ~30 lines from the job:```
[ RUN      ] ServeRetryTest.test_retry_window_reschedule
...
E  serve/retry_manager.cc:142] retry scheduled at t=120ms but window moved to 90ms -> dropping request
E  serve/retry_manager.cc:158] unexpected state: reschedule after cancel
[  FAILED  ] ServeRetryTest.test_retry_window_reschedule (23 ms)
```

jamie: hmm that error about "reschedule after cancel" rings a bell. We had a change to the retry jitter logic in #3970. Might be a race with the cancel path.

maria: locally `bazel test //serve:retry_tests --runs_per_test=50` passes for me on mac. When I run in docker linux-amd64 with `--runs_per_test=200` I can repro once (approx), logs match CI.

lee: can you run with TSAN or put in a tight sleep to widen the window? Might make the race deterministic for debugging.

maria: added a quick repro script:```bash
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/workspace -w /workspace redwood/build:linux-bazel \
  bash -c 'bazel test //serve:retry_tests --runs_per_test=200 --test_arg=--seed=12345'
```
ran it twice, failed once.

ci-bot: @maria requested rerun of job redwood/serve/linux-amd64#6721 (retry queue). Re-triggered.

maria: thanks. @srini any tips on a bisect path? test-runner-bot has been flaky historically around scheduling.

srini: try bisecting between v3.8.1 and HEAD with the nightly runner image. If it only fails on linux, narrow to libc / glibc changes or epoll timing. Also check the change to retry jitter in #3970 (jamie mentioned).

jamie: I'll spin a reproduce job with extra logging enabled in retry_manager (print cancel/reschedule stack + timestamps). Patch: https://git.redwood/repo/patch/patch-499?expand=1 (small). Can we run that in the failing CI image?

maria: kicked off a debug job with that patch attached to the PR. CI job id: 6721-debug-2.

test-runner-bot: Job 6721-debug-2 started on linux-amd64-runner-7. Logs streaming: https://ci.redwood/logs/6721-debug-2

lee: if the debug logs show close timestamps (<5ms) between cancel and schedule, that's the race. We should consider moving to atomic state transitions or handling the "reschedule after cancel" as noop + metric.

oncall: pinging @eng-runtime oncall to eyeball infra differences for linux-amd64 runner (kube node kernel v5.15 vs local 6.x).

srini: also add a flaky test tag and a temporary CI rerun for this PR, so it doesn't block mergers while we triage.

maria: done, added [flake] label to the test and requested branch rerun in PR. If debug job reproduces I'll open a bisect issue and mark owner.

jamie: debug job failed reproducibly (3/3) and logs show cancel at t=90ms then schedule at t=92ms with different task ids. Pushing a quick fix that retries only if state == SCHEDULED (rather than not-cancelled). I'll open a PR and request review from @srini and @lee.

maria: awesome — once that PR is up, can someone please trigger a full CI run on it? If green we can backport to the 3.8.x branch.

srini: will do. Also opening a follow-up to add a deterministic unit that simulates the very-tight window using a fake clock; helps prevent regressions.

lee: +1 to fake clock test. Also add a metric and alert for "reschedule-after-cancel" increments so we see it in prod if it leaks.

maria: thanks everyone — moving this to async triage. I'll update the PR with links to debug logs and the bisect issue. :thumbsup:
